description: Running 'python -m downstream.refresh candidate --tag v30.31.0 --path ../sqlglot.refresh-candidate --branch refresh/candidate-30.31.0' (the MAINTAINING.md example path) in a clean clone, while ../sqlglot.refresh-candidate already held an older candidate worktree, ended in an unhandled subprocess.CalledProcessError from 'git worktree add' (exit 128).
